description: This file contains the class definition for `Customer` controller in the OpenCart admin module, specifically handling customer management functions such as listing, filtering, and managing customer data.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Controller class for customer-related admin functions including listing, filtering, and managing customer data.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Controller class for customer-related admin functions including listing, filtering, managing customer data, and displaying customer form

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for rendering the customer list page, handling request parameters, filtering, and preparing data for the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the listing of customers, calls `getList` to retrieve customer data, and outputs the result.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of customers from the model based on filter criteria and pagination, preparing data for display.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the customer form for creating or editing a customer.

methods.name: ip
methods.description: Handles retrieval and display of customer IP addresses, including pagination, store info, and country data.

methods.name: getIp
methods.description: Returns the IP address of a customer based on request parameters and session data.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Handles fetching and displaying customer authorization tokens and related information.

methods.name: getAuthorize
methods.description: Returns authorization details for a customer, including token, IP, user agent, status, date, and delete link.

methods.name: deleteAuthorize
methods.description: Deletes a customer authorization record, validates permissions and authorization info, responds with JSON status.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides customer autocomplete suggestions based on filter name or email, returns JSON array.

methods.name: customfield
methods.description: Fetches custom fields for a customer, including custom field IDs, required status, and fetches associated addresses.
